PulsarSubscription::new joins a named durable subscription on one topic: a bare name, tenant/namespace/topic, or a full name. The first argument is the topic, and the second is the subscription. A bare name is a topic of persistent://public/default, a triple is a persistent topic of that tenant and namespace, and a full name such as non-persistent://acme/sales/pings says everything itself. The subscription is the cursor the server keeps for its readers. Every consumer that joins the same subscription shares one backlog, and a second subscription on the same topic reads every message again, from a cursor of its own. subscription() returns the name. Every setting has a default, so the two names are all a descriptor needs: Setting What it does Default subscription_type how the consumers of the subscription share it Shared ack_timeout redelivers what a handler left unsettled longer than this none batch_wait how long a batch that is not full waits for more deliveries 10 ms The subscription reports under its topic, as written: a test reads its deliveries under that name, and the AsyncAPI document reports that channel. A topic name Pulsar would refuse stops the service at startup with an error that names it, before any call to the server; PulsarTopic is the same check as a type. Topics and subscriptions reads one topic under two subscriptions of a fulfilment service.

Billing and shipping read every order of acme/sales/orders, each under a subscription of its own. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_subscriptions_descriptor.rs /// Bills every order of the `acme/sales` namespace; the subscription `billing` is its cursor. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("acme/sales/orders", "billing"))] async fn bill(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "order billed"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } /// Ships the same orders on a cursor of its own. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("acme/sales/orders", "shipping"))] async fn ship(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "order shipped"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(broker, |b| b.include(bill).include(ship)) } examples/manual/pulsar_subscriptions_descriptor.rs /// Bills every order of the `acme/sales` namespace. struct Bill; impl Handle<Order> for Bill { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order billed"); ready(Ok(())) } } /// Ships the same orders. struct Ship; impl Handle<Order> for Ship { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order shipped"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // Each subscription is a cursor of its own: `billing` and `shipping` read every order. b.include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("acme/sales/orders", "billing"), Bill, ) .build(), ) .include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("acme/sales/orders", "shipping"), Ship, ) .build(), ) }) }

PulsarTopic is a topic name checked on construction: persistent and non_persistent for literals, parse for names read at run time. A Pulsar topic name carries four things: the persistence, the tenant, the namespace and the topic. Each of the last three may hold ASCII letters, digits, -, _ and ., and none may be empty. PulsarTopic::persistent and PulsarTopic::non_persistent build a name from its parts and panic on a part Pulsar would refuse, so they are for names written in the code. PulsarTopic::parse is the form for a name that arrives at run time. It accepts a full name, a tenant/namespace/topic triple, which is persistent, or a bare name, which belongs to persistent://public/default, and returns an error for anything else. as_str is the full name, and Display writes the same. persistence, tenant, namespace and name return the parts. A descriptor and a publish parse every topic they are given the same way, so a name Pulsar would refuse never reaches the server: a descriptor stops the service at startup, and a publish returns an error. Topics and subscriptions names the topics of a fulfilment service.

Each order goes to its tenant's own topic; an order naming a tenant that is no valid name part is dropped. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_subscriptions_topic.rs /// The tenants' own order topics. #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Order)] struct TenantOrders; /// Fans orders out to their tenant's topic. The tenant comes off the wire, so its topic is /// parsed, and an order naming a tenant Pulsar would refuse is dropped here. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "router"))] async fn route(order: &Order, Out(tenants): Out<impl Publisher, TenantOrders>) -> HandlerOutcome { let Ok(topic) = PulsarTopic::parse(&format!("{}/orders/created", order.tenant)) else { tracing::warn!(order.id, tenant = %order.tenant, "no such tenant topic"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); }; match tenants.message(order).to(topic.as_str()).publish().await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(_) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), } } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("router", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(broker, |b| b.include(route).out(TenantOrders, Publish)) } examples/manual/pulsar_subscriptions_topic.rs /// The tenants' own order topics. struct TenantOrders; impl OutSlot for TenantOrders { const NAME: &'static str = "TenantOrders"; type Destination = Reads; } impl PublishedThrough<TenantOrders> for Order {} /// Fans orders out to their tenant's topic. The tenant comes off the wire, so its topic is /// parsed, and an order naming a tenant Pulsar would refuse is dropped here. struct Route; impl<Entry> Handle<Order, (), Outs<(Entry,)>> for Route where Entry: OutEntry<TenantOrders, Wire: Publisher>, { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, outs: &Outs<(Entry,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let Ok(topic) = PulsarTopic::parse(&format!("{}/orders/created", order.tenant)) else { tracing::warn!(order.id, tenant = %order.tenant, "no such tenant topic"); return Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()); }; let tenants = outs.get(TenantOrders); match tenants.message(order).to(topic.as_str()).publish().await { Ok(()) => Ok(()), Err(_) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), } } } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("router", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include(subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "router"), Route).build()) .out(TenantOrders, Publish) }) }

SubscriptionType says how the consumers of one subscription share it: Exclusive, Shared, Failover or KeyShared. PulsarSubscription::subscription_type sets it, and Shared is the default. Each handler mounted on a subscription is one consumer of it, and so is each instance of the service. A message reaches every subscription on its topic once, and the type decides which consumer of the subscription takes it: Type Who takes a message Exclusive the one consumer of the subscription; a second consumer waits until the first leaves Shared any consumer, in turn Failover the active consumer; a standby takes over when it leaves KeyShared the consumer that holds the message's key, so one key is read in order The server refuses a second Exclusive consumer as busy, and the client asks again until its operation retries run out; with the default retries it asks for ever, so the second instance does not finish starting. An Exclusive subscription belongs to a service that runs one instance. Under the test harness that second consumer is refused at startup instead, so the test fails rather than hangs. A message's key is its partition key. A retry cap needs Shared or KeyShared, because only there does the server count a message's redeliveries; a cap on the other two stops the service at startup, as Dead letters explains. Subscription types and ordering reads a shipping service under each of the four types.

Two workers on the Shared subscription workers: each task runs once, on one of them. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_subscriptions_type.rs /// Two workers attach to the subscription `workers`: each task goes to one of them. #[subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("tasks", "workers").subscription_type(SubscriptionType::Shared) )] async fn first_worker(task: &Task) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(task.id, "first worker ran the task"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } #[subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("tasks", "workers").subscription_type(SubscriptionType::Shared) )] async fn second_worker(task: &Task) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(task.id, "second worker ran the task"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("workers", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(broker, |b| b.include(first_worker).include(second_worker)) } examples/manual/pulsar_subscriptions_type.rs /// One worker; the service runs two of them on one subscription. struct Worker(&'static str); impl Handle<Task> for Worker { fn handle( &self, task: &Task, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(task.id, worker = self.0, "task ran"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("workers", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // Both workers attach to the subscription `workers`: each task goes to one of them. let worker = |name| { subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("tasks", "workers") .subscription_type(SubscriptionType::Shared), Worker(name), ) .build() }; b.include(worker("first")).include(worker("second")) }) }

PulsarSubscription::topics reads a fixed list of topics under one subscription; one seek or one retry policy covers them all. The first argument is the list, and each topic in it takes any of the three spellings a single topic takes. The subscription keeps a cursor on every topic of the list, and its consumers read all of them. A list has no single topic to name the subscription by, so it reports under the subscription's own name: a test reads its deliveries under that name, and the AsyncAPI document reports that channel. A seek from a handler moves the cursor on every topic of the list. The registration's dead-letter topic is one for the whole list. The settings and their defaults are those of PulsarSubscription. An empty list, or a name in it that Pulsar would refuse, stops the service at startup. Topics and subscriptions totals the orders of two regional topics under one subscription.

The European and the American orders, fulfilled under one subscription. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_subscriptions_topics.rs /// Reads the European and the American orders under one subscription, `regional`. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::topics(["orders-eu", "orders-us"], "regional"))] async fn fulfil(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, region = %order.region, "order fulfilled"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| b.include(fulfil)) } examples/manual/pulsar_subscriptions_topics.rs /// Fulfils the European and the American orders. struct Fulfil; impl Handle<Order> for Fulfil { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, region = %order.region, "order fulfilled"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"); RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { // Two topics under one subscription, `regional`, which is also its reported name. b.include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::topics(["orders-eu", "orders-us"], "regional"), Fulfil, ) .build(), ) }) }

TestApp::start connects PulsarBroker in process: topics, the four subscription types, dead letters, delayed retries and seeking. A test hands the harness the app main runs, unchanged, and addresses the broker by its production type, tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>(). The testing feature in [dev-dependencies] adds the in-process mode, and turns on the core's harness with it. The in-process mode has no settings of its own. The default subscription, each descriptor's settings, the retry cap and its dead-letter topic, and the payload limit are the broker's and the registration's. So a test runs the configuration production runs. It refuses what a server refuses, with the same error: a service URL the client cannot parse, a destination that is no topic name, a payload over the limit, and a handle used after shutdown. A second consumer of an Exclusive subscription is refused at once, where a server would keep it waiting. The mode keeps Pulsar's semantics: orders and persistent://public/default/orders are one topic. A message reaches every subscription over its topic once, and the subscription type picks the consumer within one. A negatively acknowledged delivery goes back to its subscription, and the dead-letter policy counts deliveries as the client does. A subscription starts at the end of its topics, and a seek moves it over the log the test published. A pattern reads a topic created later from the next listing, thirty seconds on. A header value that is not UTF-8 text fails the publish, as the client frames headers as text. A publish through the harness returns once every handler it woke has settled, a reply and a dead-letter move included. The assertions that follow read finished state. A delayed retry and a pattern's listing run on the runtime's clock, so tb.advance on a paused clock drives both. What only a server has is for a live test. Testing a Pulsar service tests a card payments service in process.

The dependency line: [dev-dependencies] ruststream-pulsar = { version = "0.8", features = ["testing"] } The first test publishes an empty payment and reads how the handler settled it. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_empty_payment_is_dropped() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 0 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 0 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::drop()); Ok(()) } examples/manual/pulsar_testing.rs #[tokio::test] async fn an_empty_payment_is_dropped() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 0 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 0 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::drop()); Ok(()) } A payment over the review limit is retried after a minute. On a paused clock the minute passes when the test advances it. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_testing.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_held_payment_is_read_again_after_the_review_delay() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 50_000 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(REVIEW)); // The clock is paused: the delay passes when the test says so, not in real time. tb.advance(REVIEW).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called(2); Ok(()) } examples/manual/pulsar_testing.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_held_payment_is_read_again_after_the_review_delay() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let tb = TestApp::start(app()).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 50_000 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(REVIEW)); // The clock is paused: the delay passes when the test says so, not in real time. tb.advance(REVIEW).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("payments") .assert_called(2); Ok(()) }

TestApp::start_live runs the same test body against a running Pulsar, for what only a server has. It connects the broker through its ordinary connect, so the client dials the server and every subscription opens a real consumer. The body is the one an in-process test runs; only the start call differs. A publish, settle and advance wait on the real clock until every subscription has handled what was published to it. The wait lasts ten seconds at most, and start_live_within sets another bound. The live mode is for what the in-process mode leaves to the server: the ack timeout's own redelivery; partitioned topics, and the partition a key picks; which consumer of a Shared or KeyShared subscription the server picks, and KeyShared hash ranges; messages published while a subscription has no consumer; a second Exclusive consumer waiting, and the OperationRetries that bound the wait; the token and TLS; a backlog older than the test, which start_at replays. A server keeps what earlier runs left in it, and a subscription is a durable cursor on it. So each run reads in a subscription of its own, which starts at the end of the topic, past what earlier runs published. In the example, stand returns the server's URL from PULSAR_TEST_URL, and the live test returns early without one, so cargo test passes on a machine with no server. A job that stood a server up sets RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE=1, and a missing URL then fails the test instead of skipping it. The repository's stand is docker-compose.test.yml, a Pulsar standalone on 127.0.0.1:6650 that just brokers-up starts. Testing a Pulsar service runs the same test against a server.

The two tests share one body: one in process, one against the server at PULSAR_TEST_URL. Macros Manual examples/pulsar_testing_live.rs /// The body both modes run; only the start call differs. async fn accepts_a_payment(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("testing-live-payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start(app("pulsar://localhost:6650", "payments-svc")).await?) .await } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn against_the_stand() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(url) = stand() else { return Ok(()); }; // A subscription of this run's own: it starts at the end of the topic, past what // earlier runs published, and its cursor outlives the test on the server. let subscription = format!("payments-{}", process::id()); accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start_live(app(&url, &subscription)).await?).await } examples/manual/pulsar_testing_live.rs /// The body both modes run; only the start call differs. async fn accepts_a_payment(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("testing-live-payments") .assert_called_once() .with(&Payment { amount: 100 }) .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } #[tokio::test] async fn in_process() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start(app("pulsar://localhost:6650", "payments-svc")).await?) .await } #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn against_the_stand() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(url) = stand() else { return Ok(()); }; // A subscription of this run's own: it starts at the end of the topic, past what // earlier runs published, and its cursor outlives the test on the server. let subscription = format!("manual-payments-{}", process::id()); accepts_a_payment(TestApp::start_live(app(&url, &subscription)).await?).await }
本指南按处理器的结果结算 Pulsar 消息，用确认超时限制未结算的投递，并一次结算整批消息。 示例是一个库存服务。 它为订单预留库存，并记录仓库盘点扫描得到的库存数量。 Stock 代表库存服务的客户端，应用在启动时打开它。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Reservation { order: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } /// Reserves stock for an order. A reservation left unsettled for a minute comes back. #[subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("reservations", "inventory").ack_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60)) )] async fn reserve(reservation: &Reservation, State(stock): State<Arc<Stock>>) -> HandlerOutcome { match stock.reserve(reservation).await { Ok(()) => { tracing::info!(reservation.order, reservation.quantity, "stock reserved"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } // No answer: the subscription hands the reservation out again at once. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), Err(Refusal::UnknownSku) => { tracing::warn!(reservation.order, "unknown SKU, reservation dropped"); HandlerOutcome::drop() } } } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] struct Reservation { order: u64, sku: String, quantity: u32, } /// A reservation left unsettled for a minute comes back. fn reservations() -> PulsarSubscription { PulsarSubscription::new("reservations", "inventory").ack_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60)) } /// Reserves stock for an order. struct Reserve; impl Handle<Reservation, (), (), (), Clients> for Reserve { async fn handle( &self, reservation: &Reservation, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { match ctx.state().stock.reserve(reservation).await { Ok(()) => { tracing::info!(reservation.order, reservation.quantity, "stock reserved"); Ok(()) } // No answer: the subscription hands the reservation out again at once. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), Err(Refusal::UnknownSku) => { tracing::warn!(reservation.order, "unknown SKU, reservation dropped"); Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()) } } } } reserve 返回的值决定这条消息在 Pulsar 上的去向： 结果 在 Pulsar 上 ack 消息被确认，不再回来 retry 消息被否定确认，并立即再次投递 retry_after(delay) 消息被扣留 delay，然后被否定确认 drop 消息被确认 没有应答的库存服务，下一次调用时可能就会应答，所以 reserve 选择重试。 消息回到订阅，在 Shared 订阅上，可能由另一个消费者接手。 没有任何商品使用的 SKU 始终是未知的，所以 reserve 丢弃这次预留。 Pulsar 没有永久拒绝消息的命令，所以 drop 确认消息，消息就此消失。 一直失败的消息改为经由死信主题离开订阅。 客户端在后台发送确认。 返回的结算先在消费者上排队，片刻之后 Broker 才记录它。 服务如果在这之间停止，下次启动时会再次收到这条消息，所以 Pulsar 对每条消息至少投递一次。 处理消息时，要让第二次投递不造成损害，比如以订单 id 作为工作的键。
无人结算的投递会一直留在它的消费者那里。 描述符上的 ack_timeout 为它设定期限：期限一过，客户端就请求 Broker 再次投递这条消息。 没有设置时，这样的消息只在它的消费者断开连接后才会回来。 把超时设得比处理器的最长耗时更长。 超时到期时仍在工作的处理器，会收到同一条消息的第二次投递。 和 retry 一样，每次重新投递都计入重试上限。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Count { sku: String, on_hand: u32, } /// Records the stock counts of a warehouse scan, many counts per call. #[subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("stock-counts", "inventory").batch_wait(Duration::from_millis(250)) )] async fn record_counts(counts: &[Count], State(stock): State<Arc<Stock>>) -> HandlerOutcome { stock.record(counts).await; tracing::info!(counts = counts.len(), "stock counts recorded"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] struct Count { sku: String, on_hand: u32, } /// A batch that is not full closes 250 ms after its first count. fn stock_counts() -> PulsarSubscription { PulsarSubscription::new("stock-counts", "inventory").batch_wait(Duration::from_millis(250)) } /// Records the stock counts of a warehouse scan; `Ok` settles the whole batch. struct RecordCounts; impl Handle<[Count], (), (), (), Clients> for RecordCounts { async fn handle( &self, counts: &[Count], _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> Result<(), Vec<HandlerOutcome>> { ctx.state().stock.record(counts).await; tracing::info!(counts = counts.len(), "stock counts recorded"); Ok(()) } } 接收切片的处理器是批处理器。 Pulsar 客户端一次交出一条消息，所以由服务组装批。 批满了，或者从第一条消息起已过去 batch_wait 的时间（这里是 250 毫秒），批就结束。 一个结果结算批中的每条消息。 在手写形式中，Ok(()) 确认整批，Err(outcomes) 用各自的结果分别结算每条消息。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App<State = Clients> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("inventory", "0.1.0")) .on_startup(async move |()| Ok::<_, Infallible>(Clients::default())) .with_broker(PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.include(reserve) .include(record_counts.batch(nonzero!(64))) }) } src/main.rs fn app() -> impl App<State = Clients> { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("inventory", "0.1.0")) .on_startup(async move |()| Ok::<_, Infallible>(Clients::default())) .with_broker(PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.include(subscriber(reservations(), Reserve).build()) .include( subscriber(stock_counts(), RecordCounts) .batch(nonzero!(64)) .build(), ) }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } 挂载点上的 batch(n) 是最大的批，这里是 64 条盘点记录。 on_startup 只打开一次客户端，处理器把它们作为应用的状态读取。
示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用，用 TestApp::with_state 代替 on_startup。 它们故意让库存服务失败，并检查每次投递的结果。 和服务器一样，进程内 Pulsar 会把被否定确认的消息交还给订阅。 确认超时之后的重新投递由服务器完成，本 crate 的测试在运行中的 Pulsar 上检查它。
本指南安装 ruststream-pulsar，启动一个本地 Pulsar，并让第一个服务连上它运行。

Cargo.toml [dependencies] ruststream = { version = "0.8", features = ["macros", "json", "logging"] } ruststream-pulsar = "0.8" serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] } tracing = "0.1" [dev-dependencies] ruststream-pulsar = { version = "0.8", features = ["testing"] } tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt"] } ruststream 是框架本身：macros 提供属性宏，json 提供默认编解码器，logging 把服务的日志打印到终端。 ruststream-pulsar 是 Pulsar Broker。 它的 testing feature 加入测试所用的进程内 Pulsar。 这个 Broker crate 有以下两个 feature，默认都不启用： Feature 提供的内容 testing TestApp 背后的进程内 Pulsar asyncapi 生成的 AsyncAPI 文档中的 Pulsar 绑定
Pulsar 客户端在构建时编译 Pulsar 的协议定义，所以构建需要 protoc，即 Protocol Buffers 编译器。 在 Debian 和 Ubuntu 上，它由 protobuf-compiler 提供；在 macOS 上，用 brew install protobuf 安装。 不在 PATH 中的 protoc 由 PROTOC 环境变量指定。

standalone 模式的 Pulsar 在一个容器里同时运行 Broker 及其存储： compose.yaml services: pulsar: image: apachepulsar/pulsar:4.1.2 command: bin/pulsar standalone ports: - "6650:6650" - "8080:8080" environment: # The address the broker hands to clients outside the container. PULSAR_PREFIX_advertisedAddress: 127.0.0.1 PULSAR_PREFIX_advertisedListeners: pulsar://127.0.0.1:6650 healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/admin/v2/brokers/health || exit 1"] interval: 10s retries: 30 启动它，并等到它进入健康状态： docker compose up -d --wait Broker 监听 localhost:6650，管理 API 监听 localhost:8080。 Pulsar 在第一次使用主题时创建它，所以服务不需要任何准备工作。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct Order { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "billing"))] async fn take_order(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return HandlerOutcome::drop(); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("billing", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.include(take_order) }) } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] struct Order { id: u64, amount_cents: u64, } struct TakeOrder; impl Handle<Order> for TakeOrder { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { if order.amount_cents == 0 { tracing::warn!(order.id, "order without an amount dropped"); return ready(Err(HandlerOutcome::drop())); } tracing::info!(order.id, order.amount_cents, "order taken"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("billing", "0.1.0")) .with_broker(PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.include(subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "billing"), TakeOrder).build()) }) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } take_order 从 orders 主题读取 JSON 订单。 带金额的订单被确认，没有金额的订单被丢弃。 Pulsar 只通过具名的订阅读取主题。 PulsarSubscription::new 指定主题和订阅，这里的订阅是 billing。 订阅是服务器保存的一个游标，所以服务重启后会从停下的地方继续。 PulsarBroker::new 接收服务 URL，只把它记录下来。 连接在服务启动时才打开。 #[ruststream::app] 把 app 变成 main；在手写形式中，run_main 做同样的事。 运行服务： cargo run -- run 在另一个终端里，用镜像自带的客户端发布一个订单： docker compose exec pulsar bin/pulsar-client produce orders \ -s ';' -m '{"id":1,"amount_cents":1250}' -s ';' 让消息保持完整：默认情况下，客户端会在每个逗号处把它拆开。 服务记录一条带订单 id 的 order taken 日志。 Ctrl+C 停止服务。
示例文件里还有两个测试。 每个测试都用 TestApp::start 启动同一个 app，发布一个订单，然后检查 take_order 如何结算它。 在测试中，PulsarBroker 连接的是进程内 Pulsar，所以测试不需要服务器： cargo test 测试 Pulsar 服务逐一讲解这些测试，以及进程内 Pulsar 模拟了什么。

基于 pulsar crate 的服务要自己构建客户端、消费者循环和生产者。 下表列出每一部分在 RustStream 中的位置： pulsar crate RustStream Pulsar::builder(url, TokioExecutor).build().await PulsarBroker::new(url)，由运行时建立连接 .with_auth(Authentication { name: "token", .. }) PulsarBroker::token .with_operation_retry_options(..) PulsarBroker::operation_retries client.consumer().with_topic(..).with_subscription(..) 加上对消费者的循环 PulsarSubscription 上的一个 #[subscriber] 处理器 .with_subscription_type(..) 描述符上的 subscription_type .with_topics([..])、.with_topic_regex(..) PulsarSubscription::topics、PulsarSubscription::pattern 反序列化 msg.payload.data 处理器的参数类型，由编解码器解码 consumer.ack(&msg)、consumer.nack(&msg) 处理器的结果（消息确认） .with_dead_letter_policy(..) 挂载点上的 max_attempts(n) 和 dead_letter(topic)（重试与死信） .with_unacked_message_resend_delay(..) 描述符上的 ack_timeout consumer.seek(..) 挂载点上的 start_at，或处理器中的定位句柄（重放与定位） client.producer().with_topic(..).build() 和 send_non_blocking 回复或 Out 参数，经由发布策略发送（发布与回复） producer::Message { partition_key, properties, .. } partition_key 步骤；消息头变成属性
生产集群要求 TLS 和认证，服务则要决定等待集群多久、发送多大的消息。

src/main.rs /// Where the cluster is and who the service is, as the deployment provides them. struct Cluster { url: String, token: String, } impl Cluster { fn from_env() -> Self { let read = |name: &str| env::var(name).unwrap_or_default(); Self { url: read("PULSAR_URL"), token: read("PULSAR_TOKEN"), } } } fn broker(cluster: Cluster) -> PulsarBroker { // Ten tries, three seconds apart; then the error. let retries = OperationRetries::attempts(nonzero!(10u32)).delay(Duration::from_secs(3)); PulsarBroker::new(cluster.url) .token(cluster.token) .operation_retries(retries) // The cluster runs with `maxMessageSize=10485760`. .max_message_size(nonzero!(10_485_760usize)) } 部署环境通过环境变量提供服务 URL 和令牌。 Pulsar 客户端只连接一个服务 URL。 由多个 Broker 组成的集群，通过它们前面的一个入口点访问：DNS 名称、负载均衡器，或者 Pulsar 代理。 pulsar+ssl:// URL 连接集群的 TLS 监听端口，按惯例是 6651。 客户端用系统信任的根证书校验服务器的证书，并校验它的主机名。 token 用 JWT 认证，客户端在连接和重新连接时发送它。 StreamNative Cloud 和启用了令牌认证的自建集群都使用这一组设置。

Broker 重启之后，客户端会自己重新连接，并为集群尚未接受的操作重新请求。 默认情况下，它不限次数地请求，间隔五秒，因此不论重启持续多久都能等过去。 OperationRetries 给这个过程设定上限：尝试十次，间隔三秒，之后操作以集群的应答失败。 这个上限覆盖查找、生产者以及每个消费者的重新连接。 它还把 Exclusive 订阅的第二个消费者从启动时的等待变成启动时的错误。 max_message_size 是一次发布能携带的最大载荷，默认 5 MiB，与服务器相同。 修改过服务器 maxMessageSize 的部署，在这里设置相同的值。 更大的发布在服务内部就会失败，不会到达集群。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "orders-svc"), reply)] async fn confirm(order: &Order) -> Confirmation { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); Confirmation { id: order.id } } fn service(broker: PulsarBroker) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| b.include(confirm)) } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { service(broker(Cluster::from_env())) } src/main.rs struct Confirm; impl Handle<Order, Confirmation> for Confirm { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Confirmation, HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); ready(Ok(Confirmation { id: order.id })) } } fn service(broker: PulsarBroker) -> RustStream { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("orders", "0.1.0")).with_broker(broker, |b| { b.include( subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "orders-svc"), Confirm) .reply() .build(), ) }) } fn app() -> RustStream { service(broker(Cluster::from_env())) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } Broker 的每项设置都是一个不发起连接的构建器步骤，所以 #[ruststream::app] 像在本地一样构建应用。 连接在服务启动时才打开。 生成的 AsyncAPI 文档报告 URL 中的主机和端口，从不包含令牌。 重放主题的服务还需要集群上命名空间的保留策略。

测试在 TestApp::start 下启动生产环境的 service，配上生产环境的 broker 和测试令牌。 进程内 Pulsar 像客户端那样解析校验服务 URL，但不会去连接集群。 使用其他协议的 URL 会让启动失败，错误信息会列出客户端支持连接的协议： the service URL's scheme "https" is not one the client dials: pulsar or pulsar+ssl TLS、令牌和重试上限只在真实集群上生效。
本指南回复 Pulsar 消息，通过 Out 槽位发布带键和消息头的消息，并在服务启动后发布。 示例是一个结账服务。 它用收据确认订单，回答报价请求，向仓库发送拣货单，并在启动时宣告自己上线。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// The receipt of an order; the type names the topic it goes to. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "receipts")] struct Receipt { order: u64, } /// Confirms each order with a receipt. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "receipts"), reply)] async fn confirm(order: &Order) -> Receipt { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); Receipt { order: order.id } } src/main.rs /// The receipt of an order; the type names the topic it goes to. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] #[outgoing(name = "receipts")] struct Receipt { order: u64, } /// Confirms each order with a receipt. struct Confirm; impl Handle<Order, Receipt> for Confirm { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Receipt, HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order confirmed"); ready(Ok(Receipt { order: order.id })) } } confirm 返回一个 Receipt，由框架发布它。 #[outgoing(name = "receipts")] 在类型上固定了主题，所以订阅者只写不带参数的 reply 子句；在手写形式中是 .reply()。 Broker 的发布策略，即 prelude 中的 Publish，是它的默认策略，所以普通的 include 就通过它回复。 Broker 保存了消息之后，发布才返回。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize)] struct QuoteRequest { request: u64, items: u32, } /// A price quote; the mount site names where it goes. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] struct Quote { request: u64, total_cents: u64, } /// Answers a quote request on `quotes`, the topic the requesting services read. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("quote-requests", "quotes"), reply("quotes"))] async fn quote(request: &QuoteRequest) -> Quote { Quote { request: request.request, total_cents: u64::from(request.items) * 1_250, } } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema)] struct QuoteRequest { request: u64, items: u32, } /// A price quote; the mount site names where it goes. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] struct Quote { request: u64, total_cents: u64, } /// Answers a quote request on `quotes`, the topic the requesting services read. struct AnswerQuote; impl Handle<QuoteRequest, Quote> for AnswerQuote { fn handle( &self, request: &QuoteRequest, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Quote, HandlerOutcome>> { ready(Ok(Quote { request: request.request, total_cents: u64::from(request.items) * 1_250, })) } } Quote 没有指定主题，所以由 reply("quotes") 在挂载点上指定；在手写形式中是 .reply().to("quotes")。 这样，同一个类型在另一个服务中可以回复到另一个主题。 请求和它的应答经由两个普通主题传递。 请求报价的服务向 quote-requests 发布，并在自己的订阅下读取 quotes。 它通过两条消息共有的 request id，把每个报价与它的请求对应起来。

documents.t: 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// A pick list for the warehouse that ships the order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "warehouse-picks")] struct Pick { order: u64, } #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Pick)] struct Picks; /// Sends each order to its warehouse, keyed by the warehouse so its picks stay in order. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "dispatch"))] async fn dispatch( order: &Order, Out(picks): Out<impl Publisher<Options = PulsarPublishOptions>, Picks>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { let mut headers = HeaderMap::new(); headers.insert("source", "checkout"); let sent = picks .message(&Pick { order: order.id }) .with_headers(headers) .partition_key(order.warehouse.clone()) .publish() .await; match sent { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(error) => { tracing::warn!(order.id, %error, "pick list not sent"); HandlerOutcome::retry() } } } src/main.rs /// A pick list for the warehouse that ships the order. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] #[outgoing(name = "warehouse-picks")] struct Pick { order: u64, } #[derive(OutSlot)] #[publishes(Pick)] struct Picks; /// Sends each order to its warehouse, keyed by the warehouse so its picks stay in order. struct Dispatch; impl<Entry> Handle<Order, (), Outs<(Entry,)>> for Dispatch where Entry: OutEntry<Picks, Wire: Publisher<Options = PulsarPublishOptions>>, { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, outs: &Outs<(Entry,)>, _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { let mut headers = HeaderMap::new(); headers.insert("source", "checkout"); outs.get(Picks) .message(&Pick { order: order.id }) .with_headers(headers) .partition_key(order.warehouse.clone()) .publish() .await .map_err(|error| { tracing::warn!(order.id, %error, "pick list not sent"); HandlerOutcome::retry() }) } } Out 槽位在处理器的函数体中发布，Picks 声明它承载的类型。 partition_key 以仓库作为每张拣货单的键。 在分区主题上，键决定分区，KeyShared 订阅保持每个键的顺序。 这个步骤来自 Broker 的 prelude，所以槽位要以 Publisher<Options = PulsarPublishOptions> 为约束才能提供它。 每个消息头都变成一个同名的消息属性。 用其他语言编写的消费者把 source 当作普通的 Pulsar 属性读取，载荷外面没有任何信封。 Pulsar 以文本形式传递属性，所以不是 UTF-8 的消息头值会让发布失败。 失败的发布返回错误，dispatch 随后重试这个订单。 载荷超过 Broker 的 max_message_size（默认 5 MiB）时，发布在发送之前就会失败。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Tells the rest of the system that checkout is up. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "service-events")] struct Started { service: String, } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("checkout", "0.1.0")).with_broker( PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.after_startup(Publish, async move |publisher| { let started = Started { service: "checkout".to_owned(), }; publisher.message(&started).publish().await }) .include(confirm) .include(quote) .include(dispatch) .out(Picks, Publish) }, ) } src/main.rs /// Tells the rest of the system that checkout is up. #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] #[outgoing(name = "service-events")] struct Started { service: String, } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("checkout", "0.1.0")).with_broker( PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650"), |b| { b.after_startup(Publish, async move |publisher| { let started = Started { service: "checkout".to_owned(), }; publisher.message(&started).publish().await }) .include( subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "receipts"), Confirm) .reply() .build(), ) .include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("quote-requests", "quotes"), AnswerQuote, ) .reply() .to("quotes") .build(), ) .include(subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "dispatch"), Dispatch).build()) .out(Picks, Publish) }, ) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } .out(Picks, Publish) 把槽位连接到发布策略。 after_startup 在各个订阅打开之后运行一次，并得到它指定的策略的一个发布者，checkout 用它在 service-events 上宣告自己上线。 失败的钩子会让服务在启动时停止。 发布者在第一次向某个主题发布时为它打开一个生产者，shutdown 关闭这些生产者。 应用之外的代码从 Broker 取得发布者：服务启动之前用 PulsarBroker::publisher，启动之后用 ConnectedPulsarBroker::publisher。
示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用。 published 检查到达某个主题的内容及其消息头，tb.out::<Picks>() 检查槽位的发布所带的键。 进程内 Pulsar 像客户端那样封装消息头和键，所以服务器会拒绝的消息头同样会让测试失败。
本指南再次读取 Pulsar 主题保留的日志：每次启动都从头读取，或者从处理器定位到的位置读取。 订阅是主题日志上的一个游标，由服务器保存。 定位移动这个游标，订阅从新的位置继续读取。 示例是一个搜索服务。 它维护由账簿构建的账户余额，以及订单的搜索索引。 Search 代表搜索集群的客户端。

PulsarPosition 指定主题日志中的一个位置： 位置 在哪里 PulsarPosition::earliest() 保留的最旧消息 PulsarPosition::latest() 日志末尾：只有定位之后发布的消息 PulsarPosition::timestamp(millis) 在该时刻或之后发布的第一条消息，时间以自 Unix 纪元起的毫秒数表示 PulsarPosition::MessageId(..) 一条已投递的消息，从它的 Position 读取

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Rebuilds the account balances from the oldest retained entry on every startup. #[subscriber( PulsarSubscription::new("ledger", "balances"), start_at(PulsarPosition::earliest()) )] async fn project(entry: &Entry) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(entry.account, entry.amount_cents, "balance updated"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// Rebuilds the account balances; the mount site starts it at the oldest retained entry. struct Project; impl Handle<Entry, (), (), (), Clients> for Project { fn handle( &self, entry: &Entry, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(entry.account, entry.amount_cents, "balance updated"); ready(Ok(())) } } start_at 在服务每次启动时对订阅执行定位。 balances 每次启动都从保留的最旧条目开始读取账簿，所以余额从零开始重建。 没有 start_at 时，已有的订阅从它的消费者停下的地方继续，新订阅则从主题末尾开始。 Pulsar 有自己的初始位置，但它只在创建订阅时生效。 start_at 对已经存在的订阅同样生效。 每个启动的实例都会移动共用的游标，所以带 start_at 的服务，其任一实例启动时，各实例都会重放日志。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "orders")] struct Order { id: u64, } /// Indexes each order; a lost index sends the subscription back to the oldest retained order. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "search-index"))] async fn index( order: &Order, Ctx(seeker): Ctx<SeekHandle>, State(search): State<Arc<Search>>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { match search.index(order).await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), Err(SearchError::IndexLost) => { tracing::warn!(order.id, "index lost, indexing every order again"); if seeker.seek(PulsarPosition::earliest()).await.is_err() { return HandlerOutcome::retry(); } HandlerOutcome::ack() } } } src/main.rs #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] #[outgoing(name = "orders")] struct Order { id: u64, } /// Indexes each order; a lost index sends the subscription back to the oldest retained order. struct Index; impl Handle<Order, (), (), PulsarContext, Clients> for Index { async fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, PulsarContext, Clients>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { match ctx.state().search.index(order).await { Ok(()) => Ok(()), Err(SearchError::IndexLost) => { tracing::warn!(order.id, "index lost, indexing every order again"); ctx.context(SeekHandle) .seek(PulsarPosition::earliest()) .await .map_err(|_| HandlerOutcome::retry()) } } } } SeekHandle 是订阅自己的定位器，index 从 Pulsar 上下文读取它。 搜索集群丢失索引时，index 定位到保留的最旧订单，每个订单都会被重新索引。 在手写形式中，处理器把 PulsarContext 声明为它的上下文，并用 ctx.context(SeekHandle) 读取定位器。 定位移动的是整个订阅：它的每个消费者、它读取的每个主题和每个分区。 已经为订阅排队的投递会被丢弃，日志从新的位置开始读取。 另外两种定位很常用： PulsarPosition::timestamp(millis) 跳过一段坏数据：订阅从这段之后发布的第一条消息继续。 用 Ctx<Position> 读取的投递位置，会再次投递恰好这条消息，然后按顺序投递日志的其余部分。 批处理器以同样的方式通过 PulsarBatchContext 定位。 它带有定位器，但没有位置，因为一批跨越许多消息。

重放读取的是主题仍然保存的内容。 默认情况下，每个订阅都确认了一条消息之后，Pulsar 就删除它。 命名空间上的保留策略按大小或时间保存已确认的消息： docker compose exec pulsar bin/pulsar-admin namespaces set-retention public/default \ --size 1G --time 3d 非持久主题什么都不保存，所以在那里定位不会重放任何东西。

本指南立即或稍后重试一条 Pulsar 消息，限定投递次数，并把一直失败的消息转入由处理器读取的死信主题。 Pulsar 自己重新投递消息，所以重试不发布任何东西。 挂载点声明上限和死信主题，Pulsar 客户端负责执行它们。 示例是一个退款服务，它通过发卡处理商发出退款。 Processor 代表处理商的客户端，应用在启动时打开它。

处理商有三种拒绝退款的方式，每种需要不同的结果。 Busy 表示它的速率限额已经用完：立即重试仍会被拒绝，所以 retry_after 等待 30 秒。 Unavailable 表示它没有应答：retry 立即再试一次。 Declined 表示卡账户已经关闭，再试一次也是同样的答复，所以这笔退款被丢弃。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// How long a busy processor asks its callers to wait. const BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30); #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing)] #[outgoing(name = "refunds")] struct Refund { id: u64, card: String, amount_cents: u64, } /// A refund left unsettled for two minutes comes back; a wait must be shorter than that. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("refunds", "refunds").ack_timeout(Duration::from_secs(120)))] async fn process_refund( refund: &Refund, State(processor): State<Arc<Processor>>, ) -> HandlerOutcome { match processor.refund(refund).await { Ok(()) => HandlerOutcome::ack(), // Past the rate limit: a delivery right now would be refused again. Err(Refusal::Busy) => HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF), // No answer: try again at once, up to the attempt cap. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => HandlerOutcome::retry(), Err(Refusal::Declined) => { tracing::warn!(refund.id, "card declined, refund dropped"); HandlerOutcome::drop() } } } src/main.rs /// How long a busy processor asks its callers to wait. const BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30); #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Outgoing, JsonSchema)] #[outgoing(name = "refunds")] struct Refund { id: u64, card: String, amount_cents: u64, } /// A refund left unsettled for two minutes comes back; a wait must be shorter than that. fn refunds() -> PulsarSubscription { PulsarSubscription::new("refunds", "refunds").ack_timeout(Duration::from_secs(120)) } struct ProcessRefund; impl Handle<Refund, (), (), (), Clients> for ProcessRefund { async fn handle( &self, refund: &Refund, _outs: &(), ctx: &mut Context<'_, (), Clients>, ) -> Result<(), HandlerOutcome> { match ctx.state().processor.refund(refund).await { Ok(()) => Ok(()), // Past the rate limit: a delivery right now would be refused again. Err(Refusal::Busy) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(BACKOFF)), // No answer: try again at once, up to the attempt cap. Err(Refusal::Unavailable) => Err(HandlerOutcome::retry()), Err(Refusal::Declined) => { tracing::warn!(refund.id, "card declined, refund dropped"); Err(HandlerOutcome::drop()) } } } } retry 否定确认这笔退款，Broker 立即再次投递它。 retry_after 在延迟期间把退款以未确认的状态扣留在服务中，然后否定确认它。 Pulsar 的否定确认本身不带延迟，所以等待由进程负责。 在等待期间停止的进程丢失的是这段等待，而不是这笔退款：Broker 会在确认超时之后再次投递它，消费者断开连接时则立即投递。 延迟必须短于订阅的确认超时，否则超时会先把退款带回来。 处理器返回更长的延迟时，它会被拒绝，错误信息会给出这两个值。 没有确认超时的订阅接受任意延迟。

本指南选择 Pulsar 订阅的消费者如何共享它，保持每个键的顺序，并把带键的消息放到分区上。 示例是一个发货服务。 它为订单打包、跟踪发货、记账付款并为订单开具发票，这几项工作各自在不同的订阅类型下读取。

订阅的每个消费者，都是服务某个实例中的一个处理器。 订阅类型决定这些消费者如何共享消息： 类型 谁收到消息 顺序 Shared（默认） 任一消费者，轮流 不保证 KeyShared 持有该消息键的消费者 每个键内保持 Exclusive 唯一的消费者；第二个等待它离开 主题的顺序 Failover 活跃的消费者；其余待命 主题的顺序 描述符上的 subscription_type 设置类型。 同一个订阅的每个消费者都指定相同的类型。

分区主题是同一个名称下的多个主题，每个分区单独提供服务。 管理员在创建它时指定分区数： docker compose exec pulsar bin/pulsar-admin topics create-partitioned-topic \ persistent://public/default/shipments -p 3 订阅读取主题的每个分区，服务用与其他主题相同的描述符读取它。 带键的消息进入其键的哈希所对应的分区，所以同一个键的消息留在一个分区里，并保持顺序。 不带键的消息轮流进入各个分区。
示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用。 在那里，每个订阅收到其主题的每条消息各一次，由订阅类型选出消费者。 进程内 Pulsar 会立即拒绝第二个 Exclusive 消费者，所以测试会失败，而不是一直等待。 分区、KeyShared 的键范围以及服务器选中哪个消费者，都由服务器决定，本 crate 的测试在运行中的 Pulsar 上检查它们。

测试用 TestApp 运行服务自己的应用，连接的是进程内 Pulsar 或者运行中的服务器。 被测服务负责银行卡扣款。 付款到达 card-payments，它的分区键就是要扣款的账户。 处理器在 card-receipts 上以一张收据作为回复。 没有键的付款被丢弃。 超出银行即时限额的付款会被暂缓：处理器用 retry_after 要求一分钟后再投递它。 经过三次投递后，付款进入死信主题 card-payments-review。 应用由 service(broker) 构建，所以测试可以选择 Broker，而 main 使用生产环境的 Broker。 测试需要在 [dev-dependencies] 中启用 ruststream-pulsar 的 testing feature。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_keyed_payment_gets_a_receipt() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb).await } async fn a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let mut key = HeaderMap::new(); key.insert(PARTITION_KEY_HEADER, "acct-7"); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { id: 1, amount_cents: 2_500, }) .with_headers(key) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Receipt>("card-receipts") .assert_called_once() .with(&Receipt { payment: 1, account: "acct-7".to_owned(), }); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_keyed_payment_gets_a_receipt() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb).await } async fn a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb: TestApp<()>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let mut key = HeaderMap::new(); key.insert(PARTITION_KEY_HEADER, "acct-7"); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { id: 1, amount_cents: 2_500, }) .with_headers(key) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::ack()); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Receipt>("card-receipts") .assert_called_once() .with(&Receipt { payment: 1, account: "acct-7".to_owned(), }); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } TestApp::start 把 PulsarBroker 连接到进程内 Pulsar。 服务 URL 按客户端的解析方式校验，但从不去连接它。 测试按生产类型访问 Broker：tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>()。 分区键以 PARTITION_KEY_HEADER 消息头传递，所以测试用 with_headers 设置它。 Broker 把这个消息头变成消息的键，处理器再从同一个消息头把它读回来。 publish 在处理器及其回复都完成结算后才返回。 所以接下来的几行断言的是已经完成的状态：订阅者如何结算，以及什么到达了 card-receipts。 测试主体把已启动的应用作为参数接收，所以下面在服务器上运行的测试也执行它。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_payment_without_an_account_is_dropped() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { id: 2, amount_cents: 2_500, }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::drop()); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Receipt>("card-receipts") .assert_not_called(); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } src/main.rs #[tokio::test] async fn a_payment_without_an_account_is_dropped() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&Payment { id: 2, amount_cents: 2_500, }) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::drop()); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Receipt>("card-receipts") .assert_not_called(); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } settled 检查处理器返回的结果。 assert_not_called 检查没有发布任何收据。

宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_payment_the_bank_keeps_holding_goes_to_review() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; let held = Payment { id: 3, amount_cents: 250_000, }; let mut key = HeaderMap::new(); key.insert(PARTITION_KEY_HEADER, "acct-7"); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&held) .with_headers(key) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(HOLD)); // Each delivery waits `HOLD`, then the broker hands the same message over again. tb.advance(HOLD).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called(2); // The third delivery is the last one the mount site allows: after its wait, the client // moves the payment to the review topic. tb.advance(HOLD).await?; tb.advance(HOLD).await?; assert_eq!( tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .outcomes(), [Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Nack], ); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Payment>("card-payments-review") .assert_called_once() .with(&held); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } src/main.rs #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] async fn a_payment_the_bank_keeps_holding_goes_to_review() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let broker = PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("payments"); let tb = TestApp::start(service(broker)).await?; let held = Payment { id: 3, amount_cents: 250_000, }; let mut key = HeaderMap::new(); key.insert(PARTITION_KEY_HEADER, "acct-7"); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .message(&held) .with_headers(key) .publish() .await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called_once() .settled(HandlerOutcome::retry_after(HOLD)); // Each delivery waits `HOLD`, then the broker hands the same message over again. tb.advance(HOLD).await?; tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .assert_called(2); // The third delivery is the last one the mount site allows: after its wait, the client // moves the payment to the review topic. tb.advance(HOLD).await?; tb.advance(HOLD).await?; assert_eq!( tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .subscriber("card-payments") .outcomes(), [Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Nack, Outcome::Nack], ); tb.broker::<PulsarBroker>() .published::<Payment>("card-payments-review") .assert_called_once() .with(&held); tb.shutdown().await?; Ok(()) } 测试在暂停的时钟上启动，advance 让时钟前进。 一分钟的 HOLD 不花费任何时间。 retry_after 在延迟期间把付款扣留在服务中，然后否定确认它，所以 Broker 再次投递同一条消息。 重试不发布任何东西：card-payments 上唯一的消息就是测试自己的付款。 第三次投递是挂载点允许的最后一次，所以在它的等待结束后，这笔付款按到达时的样子进入 card-payments-review。 每次被暂缓的投递都记录为 Outcome::Nack。

进程内 Pulsar 读取服务器会得到的配置：Broker 的设置、每个描述符，以及每个注册的重试声明。 服务器拒绝的东西，它同样拒绝，并返回真实 Broker 会返回的错误：客户端无法解析的服务 URL、不是主题名称的目的地、Exclusive 订阅的第二个消费者，以及关闭之后仍被使用的句柄。 它模拟的是 Pulsar，而不是一个队列： 主题就是它的完整名称，所以 orders 和 persistent://public/default/orders 是同一个主题。 每个订阅收到其主题的每条消息各一次，由它的类型选出消费者。 被否定确认的消息回到它的订阅，死信策略像客户端那样统计它的投递次数。 每个主题保存自己的日志，所以定位会重放它；非持久主题不重放任何东西。 模式订阅从客户端的下一次列出开始读取新主题，即暂停的时钟上 30 秒之后。 消息头以文本属性传递，超过 max_message_size 的载荷会让发布失败。 服务器让第二个 Exclusive 消费者一直等待，而进程内 Pulsar 立即拒绝它，所以这样的测试会失败，而不是挂起。 确认超时之后的重新投递、分区主题、KeyShared 的键范围，以及订阅没有消费者时发布的消息，都需要服务器。

documents.t: 宏 手写 src/main.rs #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn a_keyed_payment_gets_a_receipt_on_a_server() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(url) = stand() else { return Ok(()); }; let subscription = format!("payments-{}", process::id()); let broker = PulsarBroker::new(url).default_subscription(subscription); let tb = TestApp::start_live(service(broker)).await?; a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb).await } src/main.rs #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)] async fn a_keyed_payment_gets_a_receipt_on_a_server() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> { let Some(url) = stand() else { return Ok(()); }; let subscription = format!("payments-{}", process::id()); let broker = PulsarBroker::new(url).default_subscription(subscription); let tb = TestApp::start_live(service(broker)).await?; a_receipt_names_the_account_of_the_key(tb).await } TestApp::start_live 把同一个应用连接到运行中的 Pulsar。 测试用 stand（示例自带的辅助函数）从 PULSAR_TEST_URL 读取地址，未设置时跳过。 RUSTSTREAM_REQUIRE_LIVE=1 把这种跳过变成失败，所以 CI 任务没有服务器就无法通过。 测试加入自己的订阅，订阅以进程命名。 新订阅从主题末尾开始，所以不会读到之前运行留下的任何东西。 断言与进程内的完全相同。 cargo test PULSAR_TEST_URL=pulsar://localhost:6650 cargo test -- --test-threads=1 服务器就是快速开始中的那一个。

documents.t: 本指南为 Pulsar 主题命名，在持久订阅下读取它们，覆盖一个主题、一组固定的主题，或模式匹配到的每个主题。 示例是一个履约服务。 它发运订单、通知顾客、汇总并审计各地区的订单，并为退货补充库存。

Pulsar 主题名称由四部分组成：persistent://public/default/orders。 第一部分是持久性，接着是租户和命名空间，最后是主题本身。 orders 这样的简单名称是 persistent://public/default/orders 的简写，tenant/namespace/topic 三段式名称同样是持久的。 public/default 是每个 Pulsar 安装一开始就有的命名空间。 持久主题会保存它的消息，直到每个订阅都确认了它们。 非持久主题把消息保存在内存中，只交给当时已连接的消费者。 因此，它适合片刻之后就失去价值的数据。 Pulsar 在第一次使用主题时创建它，所以服务只需指定它读写的主题。 服务在连接之前检查每个主题名称，格式错误的名称会让服务在启动时停止。 PulsarTopic 由各部分构建名称，或者解析来自代码之外的名称。

Pulsar 只通过订阅读取主题。 订阅是服务器保存的一个游标：它记住消费者确认过什么，并且比服务活得更久。 宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Ships every order. The subscription `fulfilment` is this service's cursor on `orders`. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "fulfilment"))] async fn fulfil(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "order shipped"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } /// Reads the same topic under a subscription of its own, so it sees every order too. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "notifications"))] async fn notify(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, "customer notified"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// Ships every order. The subscription `fulfilment` is this service's cursor on `orders`. struct Fulfil; impl Handle<Order> for Fulfil { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "order shipped"); ready(Ok(())) } } /// Reads the same topic under a subscription of its own, so it sees every order too. struct Notify; impl Handle<Order> for Notify { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, "customer notified"); ready(Ok(())) } } PulsarSubscription::new 指定主题和订阅。 fulfil 和 notify 在两个订阅下读取 orders，所以它们各自收到每一个订单。 服务的两个实例在每个订阅上共用一个游标，所以它们分摊订单，而不是把每个订单发运两次。 订阅以拥有它的服务命名：另一个服务如果使用同一个名称，就会共享它的积压。 新订阅从主题末尾开始，只看到在它之后发布的消息。 已有的订阅从它的消费者停下的地方继续，重启之后也是如此。 重放与定位讲解如何移动游标。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Totals the orders of two regions through one consumer. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::topics(["orders-eu", "orders-us"], "regional-totals"))] async fn tally(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, order.region, "order counted"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// Totals the orders of two regions through one consumer. struct Tally; impl Handle<Order> for Tally { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, order.region, "order counted"); ready(Ok(())) } } PulsarSubscription::topics 通过一个消费者、在一个订阅名下读取多个主题。 每个主题在这个名称下保有自己的游标。 所有主题共用一种载荷类型。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Audits every regional topic, those created after startup included. #[subscriber(PulsarSubscription::pattern("persistent://public/default/orders-.*", "audit"))] async fn audit(order: &Order) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(order.id, order.region, "order audited"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } src/main.rs /// Audits every regional topic, those created after startup included. struct Audit; impl Handle<Order> for Audit { fn handle( &self, order: &Order, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(order.id, order.region, "order audited"); ready(Ok(())) } } PulsarSubscription::pattern 读取完整名称与正则表达式匹配的每个主题，所以表达式要写出完整名称。 订阅读取表达式前缀指明的命名空间：persistent://acme/orders/.* 读取 acme/orders，没有 tenant/namespace/ 部分的表达式读取 public/default。 audit 读取 orders-eu 和 orders-us，以及之后创建的、完整名称与该表达式匹配的任何主题。 客户端每 30 秒重新列出一次主题。 新主题从发现它的那次列出开始读取，在那之前到达它的消息不会被投递。 表达式不是合法的正则表达式，或者其中的租户或命名空间本身写成了正则表达式时，服务会在启动时停止。

宏 手写 src/main.rs /// Restocks returned items, under the broker's default subscription. #[subscriber("returns")] async fn restock(item: &Return) -> HandlerOutcome { tracing::info!(item.order, "return restocked"); HandlerOutcome::ack() } #[ruststream::app] fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker( PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("fulfilment"), |b| { b.include(fulfil) .include(notify) .include(tally) .include(audit) .include(restock) }, ) } src/main.rs /// Restocks returned items, under the broker's default subscription. struct Restock; impl Handle<Return> for Restock { fn handle( &self, item: &Return, _outs: &(), _ctx: &mut Context<'_>, ) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), HandlerOutcome>> { tracing::info!(item.order, "return restocked"); ready(Ok(())) } } fn app() -> impl App { RustStream::new(AppInfo::new("fulfilment", "0.1.0")).with_broker( PulsarBroker::new("pulsar://localhost:6650").default_subscription("fulfilment"), |b| { b.include(subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "fulfilment"), Fulfil).build()) .include( subscriber(PulsarSubscription::new("orders", "notifications"), Notify).build(), ) .include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::topics(["orders-eu", "orders-us"], "regional-totals"), Tally, ) .build(), ) .include( subscriber( PulsarSubscription::pattern( "persistent://public/default/orders-.*", "audit", ), Audit, ) .build(), ) .include(subscriber("returns", Restock).build()) }, ) } fn main() -> ExitCode { run_main(app) } #[subscriber("returns")] 只指定主题，不指定订阅。 它以 Shared 订阅的身份加入 Broker 的 default_subscription，这里是 fulfilment。 在没有默认订阅的 Broker 上，简单名称会让服务在启动时停止，错误信息会指出这项设置。 订阅的其他所有设置，比如它的类型或确认超时，都需要描述符。
示例文件中的测试在进程内运行应用。 和在服务器上一样，主题上的每个订阅都收到发布到该主题的每条消息。 模式测试在暂停的时钟上启动，并用 tb.advance 让时钟前进 30 秒，所以下一次列出会立即到来。 测试 Pulsar 服务讲解了测试工具。
